name: Themes
summary: Four themes for all of Kairo: Glass, Minimal, Retro and Neon, on every menu, the ring and the HUD.
description: Restyles Kairo and Kairo Void from top to bottom: the main menu, the pause menu, the ring, every Kairo menu and control, and the boxes behind HUD mods and keys. Glass is bright frosted glass; Minimal is quiet dark panels with a line in your colour; Retro is square pixel frames like Minecraft's tooltips and slots; Neon is dark with glowing edges. Pick one from pictures in Visuals (Theme); each has its own options.
